You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

Drug: evacetrapib (Cholesteryl ester transfer protein inhibitor)

SBP input uses 600 mg supratherapeutic dose. These limit quantitative precision of the expected HR.", "refs": ["f_58aadd0f20c7b8", "f_342c58c5ac1a94", "f_fdb5153ab0027b", "f_30b41d9e4ecc71"]}], "against": [{"text": "The qualitative conclusion (biomarker_not_causal) is robust to these quantitative uncertainties because HDL-C non-causality is established by genetics and prior CETP failures, and even optimistic phase 3 LDL-C lowering yields an underpowered trial.", "refs": ["f_ff8d155f87441a", "calculator"]}], "would_settle": "Publication of final ACCELERATE results with observed HR and biomarker changes at 130 mg."}], "primary_category": "biomarker_not_causal", "secondary_categories": ["effect_too_small", "target_not_causal", "insufficient_data"], "confidence": "high", "departure_from_calculator": "The calculator's primary category (biomarker_not_causal) is correct and retained. However, the calculator's quantitative expected HR (0.958) relies on phase 2 biomarker data at doses (100 mg + atorvastatin for LDL-C/HDL-C; 600 mg for apoB/SBP) that do not match the phase 3 regimen (130 mg monotherapy on background statin). Phase 3 data show LDL-C lowering of -14% to -36% at 130 mg (f_342c58c5ac1a94, f_fdb5153ab0027b), which would yield an expected HR of ~0.90-0.96 — still implying <20% power. The qualitative conclusion is unchanged, but the quantitative inputs should be updated to phase 3 values when available."}
